rationale: Record two additive observability surfaces over existing rendering code. The drawlist formatter is a pure function that reads a RecordingCanvas drawlist and returns text; it draws nothing, changes no backend, and is consumed by tests. The compositing-layer trace spans wrap the existing push_effect_layers / pop_effect_layers pair with Perfetto BEGIN/END in the already-declared canvas category, and compile to no-ops in every build that does not set PULP_TRACING=ON, which is every shipping build. No rendering behavior, backend selection, or authority boundary changes.
